candidates.statement: Checkout 502s stem from payment authorization ReadTimeout: gateway->order->payment calls fail after ~2s while inventory/redis succeed, so order returns 502 to gateway.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side metrics/logs; cannot confirm whether payment is slow or unreachable.

report.explanation: Traces show payment POST /v1/authorizations ReadTimeout errors propagating to order and gateway 502s, while inventory/redis succeed. Gateway metrics show /v1/checkout 502s and p95 ~2.4s. Bounded to downstream payment latency.
